packages/testkit/src/ajv-harness.test.ts:52-54 — the second surface: 'expect(results).toHaveLength(21); … expect(failures).toEqual([]);' validating each builder's output against `packages/contracts/schemas/<kebabName>.json` via ajv, so a builder cannot satisfy the zod schema while drifting from the emitted JSON Schema.

packages/testkit/src/ajv-harness.test.ts:31-37 — the negative control: 'const result = validateAgainstEmittedJsonSchema("work-unit", { not: "a work unit" }); expect(result.valid).toBe(false); expect(result.errors.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);'.
